programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: S3 — The Tale of the Saving of the ShrewWith his father's journal and the help of his best friends Benjamin and Lily, Peter is ready for some fun and delightful new discoveries.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S2 E40 — The Wedding BadgeThe Squirrels are playing at the clubhouse when there is a knock at the door. It's delivery Chipmunk with a special delivery for Duggee and the Squirrels. Duggee opens the envelope and takes out the card inside: 'It is with very great pleasure that I invite Duggee and the Squirrels to my wedding.' King Tiger has met his perfect partner and is getting married. It's going to be a royal wedding!

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: S1 E10 — Misty Mountain MysteryThe Piris plan a trip to Tippety Top to see the famous southern lights but lose each other in an ice fog. When Nugget thinks she sees a monster, Pancake proves an unlikely hero.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: S1 E17 — The Good, the Bad and the PricklyPrickly Pear arrives in the supermarket and tries to take over Evil Pea's freezer. Supertato discovers that Prickly Pear isn't mean at all and just needs some good friends.

programme.title: Weasy Family
programme.desc: S1 E51 — Mission DetectiveWeasy turns detective when his harmonica disappears.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: S1 E26 — Mojo Draws the LineMojo and Bo were supposed to paint fresh lines on the street. But when they get into a race with Tao, the paint goes in every direction, causing wild traffic chaos.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S3 E35 — Smoochy KissBluey and Bingo want Dad all to themselves and will not let Mum have a smoochy kiss. They try to hide him all around the house, but Mum is desperate to spend a little romance time with her husband.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S2 E16 — ArmyJack is the new dog at school and the newest recruit in Rusty's Army. Jack struggles with following instructions and always forgets his hat, but Rusty will make a soldier out of him.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: S1 E36 — Zog's Miraculous Medical RemedyMadam Dragon comes to the clinic with a bad case of wingpetigo. Zog miraculously cures her but is baffled by how he did it.

programme.title: Balamory
programme.desc: S2 E6 — Dance AwayIt's the Balamory dance away, but Ava is struggling to dance like anyone else. Inspired by the Harbour Master, Ava invents her own moves, which everyone at the nursery soon follows.

programme.title: Waffle's After School Club
programme.desc: S1 E3 — Waffle's Keepy UppyThe After Schoolers play keepy uppy with balloons. Mrs Hobbs is very competitive, but it's Waffle who's the champ, keeping the last balloon up with a perfectly timed bottom bounce.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: The Superhero WishRafi's superhero wish teaches her that teamwork is the greatest power of all.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: S2 — Autumn: It's Time to Visit the AquariumWhen JoJo is interested in all the beautiful fish that Gran Gran shows her on the tablet, Gran Gran has a plan. They can visit all the fish and sea creatures at the aquarium. Whilst there, JoJo is amazed by the fish and sea creatures. To top off their fun-filled day out, JoJo meets a special friend of Gran Gran's.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: S1 E3 — Cheer Up DonkeySarah and Duck attempt to find out why their friend Donkey seems so sad.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: S1 E42 — Hide-and-SeekSmall, Tiny and Baby Soup Dragon have a race around the planet. Baby Soup Dragon wins, but the Clangers don't know that he cheated. An orange Froglet sees it all and comes up with a clever way to teach Baby Soup Dragon a lesson.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: S1 E28 — MeMo DogBaBa becomes friends with a Tweetie - a BaBa Tweetie. MeMo would like a Tweetie friend too, so at Play Time, MeMo befriends a new toy, MeMo Dog. MeMo loves playing with MeMo Dog, while BaBa enjoys playing with BaBa Tweetie. MeMo takes MeMo Dog to Yummy Time to show the Yummies. Yummy Dog loves MeMo Dog too and takes care of MeMo Dog for MeMo. MeMo lets MeMo Dog stay with Yummy Dog.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: S1 E33 — The Tombliboos Have a Very Busy DayFirst, riding on the Pinky Ponk, and then they explore the garden, seeing lots of interesting things and having fun. Finally, they return to the house to clean their teeth before bedtime.

programme.title: Cbeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: S2022 E835 — Rowan Atkinson - Dogs In DisguiseRowan Atkinson reads a hilarious story about dogs and their many disguises.

programme.title: New Zealand: Earth's Mythical Islands
programme.desc: S1 E2 — Wild ExtremesThe most extreme and wild parts of New Zealand are in the South Island, which lie towards Antarctica, in the path of the tempestuous `roaring forties'. This is home to some of the most rapidly rising mountains in the world, the Southern Alps. From hyper-intelligent parrots, to sinister snails with teeth and magical constellations of glow-worms, this is the story of New Zealand's wildest places and its most resilient pioneers, all of who must embrace radical solutions to survive.

programme.title: Art of France
programme.desc: S1 E3 — This Is the Modern WorldAndrew looks at the Impressionists of French art. Andrew plunges into one of the most wildly creative periods in the history of art, when France was changing at a rapid pace and angry young artists would re-invent how to paint, finding their muses in the bars, brothels and cabarets of Belle Époque Paris and turning the world of art on its head.

programme.title: Classic Mastermind
programme.desc: E11 — 1977:Episode 11Magnus Magnusson presents the quiz programme from Bradford University. The four contenders' specialist subjects are Zulu history 1816-1879, Stuart monarchs 1603-1714, the Salvation Army and Rupert Brooke.

programme.title: Call My Bluff
programme.desc: 12/07/1978Panel game of word definitions and deceptions hosted by Robert Robinson. Team captains Frank Muir and Patrick Campbell are joined by guest panellists Suzanne Roquette, Donny MacLeod, Angharad Rees and Christopher Casanove.

programme.title: Aberfan: The Green Hollow
programme.desc: A film poem to commemorate the 50th anniversary of the Aberfan disaster, written by Owen Sheers and performed by Michael Sheen, Jonathan Pryce, Sian Phillips, Eve Myles and Iwan Rheon, with some contributions from the local community.

programme.title: Tish
programme.desc: Social documentary photographer and trailblazer Tish Murtha dedicated her life to documenting the lives of working-class communities in North East England.

programme.title: Ancient Worlds
programme.desc: S1 E5 — The Republic of VirtueArchaeologist and historian Richard Miles examines the phenomenon of the Roman Republic, from its fratricidal mythical beginnings, with the legend of Romulus and Remus, to the all too real violence of its end, dragged to destruction by warlords like Pompey the Great and Julius Caesar.

Bing and Sula discover that Flop is the monster. So they go back outside, where the billion, zillion stars and a huge moon are waiting for them.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S3 E36 — DirtJudo desperately wants to play in the dirt with Bluey and Bingo, but she is not supposed to get herself dirty.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S2 E17 — Fancy RestaurantBluey and Bingo want Mum and Dad to be romantic, so they set up a special evening for the two at their fancy restaurant. Everything goes according to plan, until chef Bingo's special arrives.

programme.title: Go Jetters

Can the Go Jetters fix their own 'glitch' and save the festival?

programme.desc: S2 — Alligator-Shark ShowdownA storm carries sharks into a swamp, so the Octonauts must help all the creatures coexist.

programme.title: Wonderblocks

programme.title: Justin's House
programme.desc: S4 E15 — Growing GloopJustin has started a wonderful plant collection, so Mr Bloom delivers a special new flower to Justin's House along with a mysterious Super Swellberry, which contains magical growing gloop to help the plant grow.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: S1 E34 — Talkie TaxiBing and Sula discover a new toy at Amma's crèche - a talking ride-on car. It seems like fun until talkie taxi keeps saying the same thing over and over again. programme.title: Yakka Dee
programme.desc: S1 E20 — BedYakka Dee! celebrates children communicating - because talking fills you up with whizz, pop, bang! In this episode, Dee encourages a friend to say 'car' and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of different beds - a big bed, a baby bed, even a bed for a bear! There are bunk beds, twin beds, comfy beds and jumpy beds. Dee dresses as a princess and climbs into a lumpy bed, then falls asleep on a moon bed.

programme.title: Treasure Planet
programme.desc: A rebellious teenager obtains a map leading to the planet where a notorious space pirate hid his treasure. Joining a spaceship crew, he embarks on a perilous journey in search of the loot - unaware that the vessel's cyborg cook is planning a mutiny. Animated sci-fi adventure based on the plot of Treasure Island, with the voices of Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Brian Murray and Emma Thompson.

programme.title: The Little Mermaid
programme.desc: Underwater princess Ariel becomes bored with her aquatic existence and spends her time spying on humans, much to the annoyance of her father. Longing to live on land, she strikes a deal with a banished sea witch in order to become human and meet a prince - but there is a price to be paid. Disney's animated adventure, with the voices of Jodi Benson, Christopher Daniel Barnes and Rene Auberjonois.

programme.title: Elio
programme.desc: Elio, a misfit kid, is mistaken for Earth's ambassador in space and bonds with aliens while discovering his true self. Pixar animation, with the voice of Yonas Kibreab.

programme.title: The Hunchback of Notre Dame
programme.desc: A deformed bell-ringer living reclusively in a cathedral in the heart of medieval Paris is tempted out of seclusion when a gypsy festival arrives and captures his imagination. Here in the outside world, he learns the cruel government minister who raised him is hatching a plan to wipe out the gypsies, so he resolves to protect his new friends. Disney animation, with the voices of Tom Hulce, Demi Moore and Kevin Kline.

programme.title: The Good Dinosaur
programme.desc: In a world where the asteroid impact that wiped out the dinosaurs never happened, humans have evolved as a primitive species while the giant lizards remain the dominant life form on Earth. A young apatosaurus becomes separated from his family, but finds a friend in a feral human boy as he makes the dangerous journey home. Pixar animated adventure, with the voices of Raymond Ochoa and Jack Bright.

programme.title: Inspector Gadget
programme.desc: A clumsy security guard is critically injured during a run-in with a thief, so his cybernetics-expert employer transforms him into the ultimate crime-fighting machine - a bionic officer with an array of gadgets and weaponry cunningly concealed inside his body. Comedy adventure based on the 1980s cartoon series, starring Matthew Broderick, Rupert Everett and Joely Fisher.

programme.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
programme.desc: In a future ravaged by war, the superhero team makes a desperate last stand against a force of deadly robots. Their only hope is to send Wolverine back in time to the 1970s, to join forces with an earlier version of the X-Men and change the events that started the conflict. Superhero adventure sequel uniting the casts of the original movie and prequel First Class, starring Hugh Jackman, Jennifer Lawrence, James McAvoy and Michael Fassbender.

programme.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
programme.desc: The superhuman soldier becomes an operative for secret intelligence agency SHIELD, but grows suspicious of their motives. Following a battle with a mysterious cyborg assassin, he and fellow Avenger Black Widow become fugitives, and try to bring down a sinister conspiracy. Comic-book thriller sequel, starring Chris Evans, Scarlett Johansson, Samuel L Jackson and Robert Redford.

programme.title: The Beach
programme.desc: A backpacker arrives in Bangkok, where a wild-eyed veteran traveller tells him the location of a remote paradise island. When he finally makes it to the golden beaches, he discovers there is already a community in residence. All is not as it seems, however, and the blissful idyll soon turns sour. Danny Boyle's drama, starring Leonardo DiCaprio, Robert Carlyle, Virginie Ledoyen and Tilda Swinton.

programme.title: The Life Aquatic with Steve Zissou
programme.desc: An eccentric marine expert sets out in search of a legendary shark that ate his old friend and shipmate. Unfortunately the voyage is riddled with problems, including a man claiming to be his long-lost son, a pursuing pirate crew and a rival oceanographer. Wes Anderson's comedy drama, starring Bill Murray, Owen Wilson, Cate Blanchett, Willem Dafoe and Jeff Goldblum.

programme.title: The Hunchback of Notre Dame
programme.desc: A deformed bell-ringer living reclusively in a cathedral in the heart of medieval Paris is tempted out of seclusion when a gypsy festival arrives and captures his imagination. Here in the outside world, he learns the cruel government minister who raised him is hatching a plan to wipe out the gypsies, so he resolves to protect his new friends. Disney animation, with the voices of Tom Hulce, Demi Moore and Kevin Kline.

programme.title: Bambi
programme.desc: A young deer grows up in the forest, forming close friendships with other woodland creatures. When tragedy strikes, he is suddenly forced to fend for himself but ultimately becomes brave and resourceful enough to save his friends during a forest fire. Animated drama, with the voices of Bobby Stewart, Hardie Albright and Donnie Dunagan.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast
programme.desc: A prince is transformed into a hideous monster as punishment for his selfishness, and can only regain his human form by finding true love. Salvation comes in the form of a spirited village girl, who offers to take her father's place when he is imprisoned in the monster's castle. But as romance blossoms between the unlikely pair, a jealous rival suitor only sees a beast to be slain. Live-action remake of the Disney animated fairy tale, starring Emma Watson, Dan Stevens and Luke Evans, with Ewan McGregor, Emma Thompson and Ian McKellen playing the Beast's entourage of living ornaments.

programme.title: Raya and the Last Dragon
programme.desc: Chief Benja and his 'dragon nerd' daughter Raya proudly protect a luminescent stone that protects humanity from a plague borne of discord called the Druun. One poor judgement allows the darkness to return, and Raya embarks on a perilous quest to restore peace by completing a series of Indiana-Jones-style obstacles. Animated fantasy, with the voices of Kelly Marie Tran, Awkwafina, Izaac Wang and Gemma Chan.

programme.title: Elio
programme.desc: Elio, a misfit kid, is mistaken for Earth's ambassador in space and bonds with aliens while discovering his true self. Pixar animation, with the voice of Yonas Kibreab.

programme.title: Lilo & Stitch
programme.desc: A lonely little girl befriends a runaway alien that helps mend her fractured family. Live action fantasy adventure, starring Maia Kealoha and Sydney Agudong.

programme.title: Frankenweenie
programme.desc: A lonely boy uses electricity to bring his dead dog back to life. However, the presence of the animal in the neighbourhood leads to panic over a monster, while the young scientist's classmates are soon also meddling with life and death to revive their own pets. Tim Burton's stop-motion animated fantasy, with the voices of Charlie Tahan and Winona Ryder.

programme.title: Treasure Planet
programme.desc: A rebellious teenager obtains a map leading to the planet where a notorious space pirate hid his treasure. Joining a spaceship crew, he embarks on a perilous journey in search of the loot - unaware that the vessel's cyborg cook is planning a mutiny. Animated sci-fi adventure based on the plot of Treasure Island, with the voices of Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Brian Murray and Emma Thompson.

programme.title: The Jungle Book
programme.desc: A boy is raised by animals in the jungles of India, but his carefree life is threatened by the return of a fierce tiger with a grudge against humans. The youngster faces a difficult choice between remaining with his friends or returning to his own people. Live action remake of Disney's animated adventure based on Rudyard Kipling's stories, starring Neel Sethi, with the voices of Bill Murray, Ben Kingsley and Idris Elba.

programme.title: John Carter
programme.desc: An American Civil War soldier is transported to an alien planet, which is also being torn apart by conflict. He intercedes in this struggle after rescuing a princess from captivity, and must win the trust of a fierce primitive tribe to save the world. Fantasy adventure based on Edgar Rice Burroughs' series of novels, starring Taylor Kitsch and Lynn Collins.

programme.title: Conan the Barbarian
programme.desc: A child who grows up in slavery becomes a formidable warrior and a cunning thief. Taken prisoner by a victorious king, he is sent out to destroy the leader of the barbaric cult that destroyed his village and slaughtered his family. Fantasy adventure, based on the stories by author Robert E Howard, starring Arnold Schwarzenegger, Max von Sydow, James Earl Jones and Sandahl Bergman.

programme.title: Let's Be Cops
programme.desc: Two friends go to a fancy-dress party as police officers, and are amazed by how people on the street react to their uniforms. They decide to pose as cops in the hope of enjoying the perks of the job, but soon end up in over their heads with gangsters and corrupt members of the real force. Comedy, starring Jake Johnson and Damon Wayans Jr.

programme.title: Hitchcock
programme.desc: Following his success with North by Northwest, director Alfred Hitchcock makes a daring choice for his next project: an adaptation of Robert Bloch's novel Psycho. After being refused backing by the studio Hitchcock decides to pay for it himself in exchange for a percentage of the profits. Even with His wifes support, Alma Reville, the production strains the couples marriage. Fact-based drama, starring Anthony Hopkins, Helen Mirren and Scarlett Johansson.

programme.title: Young Woman and the Sea
programme.desc: Through the steadfast support of her older sister and supportive trainers, Trudy Ederle overcomes adversity to rise through the ranks of the Olympic swimming team. She then attempts to become the first woman to successfully swim the English Channel. Drama, starring Daisy Ridley and Stephen Graham.

programme.title: The Aristocats
programme.desc: A jealous butler is outraged when his employer leaves a vast fortune to her cat and kittens instead of to him, so he drives the pets to the French countryside and dumps them. However, a streetwise alley cat steps in to help the pampered felines find their way home and claim their rightful inheritance. Animated adventure, with the voices of Eva Gabor, Phil Harris and Scatman Crothers.

programme.title: Treasure Planet
programme.desc: A rebellious teenager obtains a map leading to the planet where a notorious space pirate hid his treasure. Joining a spaceship crew, he embarks on a perilous journey in search of the loot - unaware that the vessel's cyborg cook is planning a mutiny. Animated sci-fi adventure based on the plot of Treasure Island, with the voices of Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Brian Murray and Emma Thompson.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: Prince Caspian
programme.desc: The four Pevensie children are summoned back to the magical land of Narnia to find centuries have passed in their absence. War is now brewing, and the young heroes must help Prince Caspian, the rightful king of Narnia, to overthrow his cruel uncle and reclaim the throne. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Ben Barnes, William Moseley, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell and Peter Dinklage.

programme.title: Frankenweenie
programme.desc: A lonely boy uses electricity to bring his dead dog back to life. However, the presence of the animal in the neighbourhood leads to panic over a monster, while the young scientist's classmates are soon also meddling with life and death to revive their own pets. Tim Burton's stop-motion animated fantasy, with the voices of Charlie Tahan and Winona Ryder.

programme.title: The Jungle Book
programme.desc: A boy is raised by animals in the jungles of India, but his carefree life is threatened by the return of a fierce tiger with a grudge against humans. The youngster faces a difficult choice between remaining with his friends or returning to his own people. Live action remake of Disney's animated adventure based on Rudyard Kipling's stories, starring Neel Sethi, with the voices of Bill Murray, Ben Kingsley and Idris Elba.

programme.title: Lilo & Stitch
programme.desc: A lonely little girl befriends a runaway alien that helps mend her fractured family. Live action fantasy adventure, starring Maia Kealoha and Sydney Agudong.

programme.title: Wish
programme.desc: Seventeen-year-old Asha makes a wish on a star to save her kingdom from rising evil and her plea is answered by a celestial body with the power to grant further desires. Animated fantasy featuring the voice of Arianna DeBose.

programme.title: Inspector Gadget
programme.desc: A clumsy security guard is critically injured during a run-in with a thief, so his cybernetics-expert employer transforms him into the ultimate crime-fighting machine - a bionic officer with an array of gadgets and weaponry cunningly concealed inside his body. Comedy adventure based on the 1980s cartoon series, starring Matthew Broderick, Rupert Everett and Joely Fisher.

programme.title: The Proposal
programme.desc: A Canadian publishing editor working in New York faces deportation to her own country. Desperate to stay in America, she offers her assistant a promotion if he will marry her, but an immigration official becomes suspicious and the pair are forced to go to desperate lengths to look like a happy couple. Romantic comedy, starring Sandra Bullock and Ryan Reynolds.

programme.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
programme.desc: In a future ravaged by war, the superhero team makes a desperate last stand against a force of deadly robots. Their only hope is to send Wolverine back in time to the 1970s, to join forces with an earlier version of the X-Men and change the events that started the conflict. Superhero adventure sequel uniting the casts of the original movie and prequel First Class, starring Hugh Jackman, Jennifer Lawrence, James McAvoy and Michael Fassbender.

programme.title: The Bob's Burgers Movie
programme.desc: Bob Belcher and wife Linda run a hamburger restaurant in a close-knit seaside community. Stress piles on the couple's shoulders when a water main ruptures and creates a huge sinkhole in front of their business. Meanwhile, Belcher children Tina, Gene and Louise solve a murderous mystery. Animated comedy, with the voices of H John Benjamin, John Roberts, Kristen Schaal and Dan Mintz.

programme.title: Death on the Nile
programme.desc: Belgian sleuth Hercule Poirot attempts to solve a murder while on a luxury cruise down the famous Egyptian river. Mystery, based on the Agatha Christie novel, directed by and starring Kenneth Branagh, with Gal Gadot, Annette Bening and Armie Hammer.

programme.title: Young Woman and the Sea
programme.desc: Through the steadfast support of her older sister and supportive trainers, Trudy Ederle overcomes adversity to rise through the ranks of the Olympic swimming team. She then attempts to become the first woman to successfully swim the English Channel. Drama, starring Daisy Ridley and Stephen Graham.

programme.title: A Bug's Life
programme.desc: Well-meaning ant Flick lands his colony in trouble when he accidentally disposes of an offering meant for a swarm of greedy grasshoppers - who promptly promise a horrible revenge. Faced with the imminent destruction of the anthill, he sets out to save the situation by enlisting the help of a few would-be heroes - an out-of-work troupe of bugs from a low-rent flea circus. Pixar animation, with the voices of Dave Foley, Kevin Spacey and Julia Louis-Dreyfus.

programme.title: The Wild Geese
programme.desc: (1978) A-list action adventure with Richard Burton, Roger Moore and Richard Harris. The heat is on for the Wild Geese as they parachute into a hostile African nation to rescue its imprisoned leader...

programme.title: Gung Ho
programme.desc: (1943) Drama based on a true story, starring Randolph Scott, Alan Curtis and Noah Berry Jr. In WWII, a rag tag band of soldiers try to take back vitally strategic territory.

programme.title: Chief of Station
programme.desc: (2024) Spy thriller starring Aaron Eckhart. Secrets stray too close to home for a former CIA European Station Chief when his wife's tragic death forces him to question everything he thought he knew...

programme.title: A Reason To Live, A Reason To Die
programme.desc: (1972) Western with James Coburn and Telly Savalas. Branded a coward for surrendering his fort to the Confederates, a Union colonel recruits seven condemned men for a daring mission to recapture it.

programme.title: Four Fast Guns
programme.desc: (1960) Western with James Craig. A former gunslinger tries to restore order to a lawless town, but is foiled by the efforts of an evil saloon owner whose infirmity grants him immunity from violence.

programme.title: Angel and the Badman
programme.desc: (1947) Western with the legendary John Wayne. A wounded gunslinger is taken in by a Quaker girl, who inspires him to give up his old ways - until his past catches up with him and puts her in danger.

programme.title: McLintock!
programme.desc: (1963) Western starring John Wayne, Maureen O'Hara and Patrick Wayne. A wealthy rancher must navigate warring factions in the Wild West while also fighting to save his troubled marriage.

programme.title: Air Rescue
programme.desc: Fly with the pilots and intensive care paramedics of The Westpac Lifesaver Rescue Helicopter Service who provide emergency medical treatment and assistance to those in life-threatening situations.

programme.title: Wish You Were Dead
programme.desc: (2017) Thriller with Emily Rose. Wishing for a better life for her and her daughter, a struggling mother makes a pact with two strangers who say they can 'eliminate' her problems.

programme.title: An Organized Killer
programme.desc: (2021) Thriller with Allison McAtee. Needing help with her full but chaotic life, Grace hires a live-in assistant. And once Lilith is invited in, there's nothing she won't do... to get what she wants.

programme.title: Killer Mom
programme.desc: At her father's funeral, Allison meets her birth mother who has a plan to stop her from inheriting $40-million. Starring Karen Cliché (2017)

programme.title: Dating to Kill
programme.desc: (2019) Cradle-robbing thriller with Clare Kramer. Jessica is shocked when her daughter starts dating an older man. But that soon turns to terror when she discovers her lethal connection to him...

programme.title: You Belong To Me
programme.desc: (2008) Supernatural scares with Shannon Elizabeth. After her divorce, Alex rejects Michael. But when his obsession turns dark, leading to tragedy, Alex must fight a supernatural force to save her son.

programme.title: Cruel Fixation
programme.desc: (2019) Tense thriller starring Kristina Klebe. A recently widowed woman grows suspicious of her insular son's new friend. Could his seemingly strange obsession with her turn sinister?

programme.title: Big Lift
programme.desc: (1950) Drama starring Montgomery Clift and Paul Douglas. During the Berlin Blockade, two American sergeants smitten with German women struggle to navigate life and love.

programme.title: We Dive at Dawn
programme.desc: (1943) War drama starring John Mills. A WWII British submarine crew closes in on a deadly new German battleship. Just as they're ready to sink it, they run out of fuel.

programme.title: Zulu Dawn
programme.desc: (1979) All-star epic with Peter O'Toole and Burt Lancaster. Under orders to invade the Zulu nation, will Lord Chelmsford's men meet their match in the Battle of Isandlwana? Based on a true story.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: McGee, Gretchen and Squirt arrive at Camp Lakebottom to find themselves held captive by a zombie, a raging Sasquatch and a ruthless chef. Then, McGee and Buttsquat compete to see whose camp is best.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: When Squirt's stinky underwear is washed in toxic cleanser, the gitch comes alive! Then, a huge, evil leech attaches itself to Squirt's skull and turns him into Evil Squirt.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: When Sawyer closes the beach because of a giant, raging fish, McGee vows to rid the lake of Old Toothy. Then, Squirt brings home a baby, monster spider despite Rosebud's ban on pets.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: When a hulking were-chicken stalks the camp, McGee must lead the hunt to prove his innocence. Then, Buttsquat gnome-knaps one of Rosebud's garden gnomes.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: Gretchen must confront her greatest fear when the Bottom Dwellers are trapped on Screech Island. Then, McGee's eagerness for presents almost destroys the biggest monster holiday of the year.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: Armand goes into a feeding frenzy when wild marshmallows give the campers a rash. Then, McGee and the Bottom Dwellers are hopelessly outnumbered when Suzi moves to Camp Lakebottom.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: Eager to regain his lost prank mojo, McGee releases a mischievous pixy. Then, McGee gets involved in Sawyer's family troubles when he secretly invites Sawyer's estranged mum for a visit.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: Buttsquat's Teddy Bear washes up at Camp Lakebottom and hypnotises the Bottom Dwellers. Then, eager to win Buttsquat's awesome new racer, McGee challenges him to cross-Lakebottom race.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: No one believes McGee's suspicion that the suddenly ultra-cool Buttsquat is a campyre. Then, during a heat wave, McGee and the gang bring back a glacier.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: McGee is thrilled when he wins a mounted horse head. Then, McGee, Gretchen and Squirt discover another camp under the lake.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: While playing Pirates on a shipwreck the Bottom Dwellers must battle the ghost Spitbeard the Pirate. Then, a rare meatball blossom causes Squirt to grow into a giant.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: The kids ignore Rosebuds warning and summon Bloody Marty from the ominous mirror world. Then, the Bottom Dwellers summon a ghostly Groundskeeper to help take care of their overgrown soccer field.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: McGee mistakenly concocts a spray that shrinks the campers to a microscopic size. Then, McGee, desperate to win a hovercraft, enters a photo of Armand into a Sasquatch photo contest.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: The Campers and Buttsquat come across an ancient pyramid inhabited by mummy's! Then, something big is lurking in Lake Ickygloomy and causing trouble for Buttssquat...

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: After touching a glowing orb from outer space, McGee, Gretchen and Squirt get super fantastic mega powers! / Then, McGee is sick and confined to his bed.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: It's Western Week at camp and the gang finds themselves in the middle of a good ol' fashioned show down! Then, the Monsters tuck the Campers in to bed and warn them of the Dream Weevil.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: McGee befriends a frog-like alien creature that crash lands close by Camp Lakebottom. Then, McGee and the gang find an old Tiki Idol that comes to life after McGee plays its bongo drums.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: It's Suzi's birthday and McGee ate her gift! Desperate to find her another gift McGee grows a mutant plant. Then, the Monsters build an arcade game for the Campers based on Camp Lakebottom.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: The Campers find a time travelling clock on the beach and use it to take a trip through Camp Lakebottom's past and future. Then, the Bottom Dwellers come across a haunted cabin ride.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: McGee is shrunk down to the size of an atom and accidentally gets slurped up by Buttsquat through his smoothie! Then, Gretchen loses her Kung Fu Chi.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: A travelling salesman visits Lakebottom one rainy day and sells McGee a magic pencil. Then, looking to beat his rivals at the Ickygloomy Slopstical Course Race, McGee summons a Trainer Titan.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: In an effort to enter the Camp Sunny Smiles beauty pageant Gretchen looks to connect with her girly side. Then, McGee and Buttsquat battle over who can make the best chili.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: When the campers discover a prehistoric valley near Stinky Pits, they also find a cursed gem. Then, a fake treasure hunt between the camps takes a real and dangerous turn.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: During an unfair polo match, McGee falls down an armadillo and wakes up in Bottomland, a bizarre version of Camp Lakebottom. Then, McGee builds Clayton, a magical clay Golem who follows his commands.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: McGee, Gretchen and Squirt accidentally disturb the potato King. Then, McGee summons a 'Monster Hunter,' doppelganger 'Rosebud' from another dimension.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: McGee, Gretchen and Buttsquat must beat Haggis MacJockstrap in a round of golf. Then, McGee convinces Sawyer to spruce up his 'Creepbook' account.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: McGee summons the Moon Dervish who will bring the Apocalypse unless a sasquatch dances for him. Then, McGee and Squirt have a falling out.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: Gretchen, McGee and Squirt get trapped by witch who forces the campers into pizza slave labour. Then, Suzi gives Buttsquat a rare action figure that was sent in a care package meant for McGee.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: McGee vows to protect Lakebottom's supernatural secrets from the prying host. Then, the campers befriend Poe, an elderly, former Lakebottom camper.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: The campers summon Armand's old rival, Doofus the Clown, who vows to destroy the campers. Then, McGee prepares the 'best prank ever'.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: Eager to take the 'Scare and Freak Champ' title from Gretchen, McGee accidentally summons Percy, a ghost with a very 'fiery' personality. Then, the Bottomdwellers film Armand's horror masterpiece.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: When McGee, Gretchen and Squirt become lost, deep in the schwamp, McGee and Gretchen argue about the right way back to Lakebottom. Then, Buttsquat challenges the CLB gang to a Capture the Flag game.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: The campers build a race car to help Sawyer relive his pro-racing days. Then, Nanny Num Nums comes to Lakebottom.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: Suzi invites her parents for a visit to Camp Lakebottom. Then, the campers train to be Sawyer's Zombie Scouts.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: Squirt is eager to assist his idol, Dr. Sapstein, on his latest quest for the rare mocker bird. Then, McGee discovers a paintbrush that unleashes Sawyer's creative genius.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom

programme.title: Greatest Escapes of WWII
programme.desc: E1Colditz Castle, the foreboding Nazi fortress that became a university of escapology; The Great Escape, and the doomed airmen of Stalag Luft Three; and the most daring breakout of them all, the ‘Warburg Wire Job’.

programme.title: Greatest Escapes of WWII
programme.desc: E2An adrenaline-fuelled dash through nazi-occupied Europe known as ‘The Flight of the Crow’, a death-defying escape across the world’s most perilous mountain range, and the largest escape of world war two - by men who chose death over dishonour.

programme.title: Greatest Escapes of WWII
programme.desc: E3The German mass breakout that stunned wartime Britain, the astonishing secret behind the daring escape of an American bomber crew trapped in the Soviet Union, and the Trojan Horse of Stalag Luft Three.

programme.title: Greatest Escapes of WWII
programme.desc: E4The Russian soldier who led a desperate outbreak from a secret Nazi death camp, Operation Chicken - an audacious plan to flee an escape-proof Japanese prison camp, and the pilots whose bold bid for freedom won the admiration of their enemies.

programme.title: Greatest Escapes of WWII
programme.desc: E5The elite German submariners who caused havoc in the heart of the American desert, the playboy pilot they couldn’t cage, and the young lovers whose escape defied all odds.

programme.title: Greatest Escapes of WWII
programme.desc: E6Hitler’s last soldier in America who defied the FBI for 40 years, the Auschwitz prisoners who releaved the secrets of the death camps, and the merciless Nazi who almost got away.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E6The story of the trench warfare from the First World War is well known. What is less well known is that the efficiency of the railway networks of both sides helped cause that stalemate.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E1Ranged weapons guarantee a warrior's best chance of survival. International experts survey history’s most important ranged weapons, from the Roman spear and the English longbow, right up to the futuristic railgun.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E2Examining how warfare entered a new dimension as attacks from the skies became possible with weapons from incendiary arrows to drones.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E1The Avro Lancaster is the legendary British heavy bomber that carved its place in history with Bomber Command during World War 2. That conflict saw over seven thousand of these iconic aircraft come off the production line.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E2Unusually, we look at the later, clipped wing version flown by Czech refugee pilots in the UK during WW2. We get close-up with a beautifully restored example, fly her and unearth long unseen test and operational footage.

programme.title: Commando Missions
programme.desc: E1In the north of Crete, six commandos land in a cove. On this island that has been occupied for two years, they have been given a high-risk mission—to infiltrate the Heraklion airfield to destroy the Luftwaffe bombers and fighter planes.

programme.title: Commando Missions
programme.desc: E2December 7th, 1942. Off the coast of France, ten British commandos board five canoes in the middle of the ocean. Their objective: to paddle to the Gironde estuary, then up the river to Bordeaux to sabotage German ships.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E7Historian Neil Faulkner tells the story of Lawrence of Arabia and his pioneering guerilla warfare against the railways of the Ottoman Empire.

programme.desc: E5The aircraft capable of delivering the payload of a B17, in a single post war air frame. The many variants of this single piston engined fighter bomber helped dominate the air to ground attack role in Vietnam, earning quite a reputation.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E6The definitive combat helicopter saw first blood in South East Asia and has been transport, gunship, smoke ship, command centre, MediVac and dozens of other roles. We hear and see it's hair raising missions and watch it earn its fame.

programme.title: Hitler's Engineers
programme.desc: E1Albert Speer was Hitler’s favorite architect and a central figure within the Führer’s inner circle. Speer’s buildings helped cement Hitler’s position and push Germany towards war.

programme.title: Hitler's Engineers

programme.desc: E6The shadowy world of special operations is brought vividly to life in this episode. Jason and Bruce handle Rusty Firmin’s SAS respirator, worn during the dramatic Iranian Embassy Siege of 1980.
